firstContext: 💬 Ecrin: "Stay close, yeah?"

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Lesiba freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Sign — a wild turkey, iridescent feathers passed here recently. Fresh prints. Close, maybe.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ SYSTEM: "The long game, little hoarders. A GRANARY. Stockpile 20,000 kcal, 500 wood and 2,000 kcal of PRESERVED food — food that WAITS. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The audience finds delayed gratification EXOTIC. So do stomachs, we are told."
That night, they bring Susan home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: Your Snare 1 tile north sits empty. You read the ground on the way in — no sign, no promise.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Nikolai Volkov ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
